blocks.text: MOSCOW — A woman in the remote Siberian region of Irkutsk has died of plague, a regional official said Friday, as a Russian media outlet reported dozens were under quarantine. Local media named her as 28-year-old laboratory technician Darya Shipilova. The “People of Baikal” news outlet said she worked for the Irkutsk Anti-Plague Institute and may have contracted pneumonic plague from a broken test tube. READ: China’s Inner Mongolia reports two cases of bubonic plague As many as 200 people with whom she may have had contact were under quarantine, the outlet added, without elaborating.
